parsed_output.email_body:
Dear HOKA Team,

We believe that HOKA shoes are more than just footwear; they are a symbol of empowerment and inclusivity in movement. To further enhance your brand's visibility and reach, we propose a collaborative Instagram post series that highlights the innovative technology and design philosophy behind HOKA shoes. This series would showcase the behind-the-scenes design process, addressing the identified gap of limited visibility on Instagram.

We propose a series of posts that include a series of images and videos showcasing the innovative technology and design philosophy behind HOKA shoes. This series would help HOKA reach a wider audience by highlighting the unique features and benefits of their products, addressing the identified gap of limited visibility on Instagram.

We look forward to discussing this opportunity further.

Best regards,
[Your Team]
